div.l: Kauȝt in a trappe ȝif it were ded or bledde
Of smale hoıı̄undis hadde sche þᵗat sche fedde
With rostid flesch or mylk or wastelbred
But sore wepte sche ȝif on of hēm were ded
Or ȝif men smot it with a ȝerde smerte
And al was concience ⁊and tendere herte
¶ Ful semely here wīmpil pȳnched was
Here nose tretis here eyen greye as glas
Here mouth ful smal ⁊and þ̉erto softe ⁊and red
But sekyrly / sche hadde a fayr forhed
It was almost a spanne brod I trowe
For hardily sche was not vndir growe
Ful fetys was here cloke as I was war
Of smale corl aboute here arm sche bar
A peyre of bedis I gaudeit al wᵗith grene
And þ̉eron heng a broche of gold so kene
On wich þ̉ere was wretyn a croıı̄und A
And aftyr Amor vincit omnia
¶ A nothir nonne with here hadde sche

¶ That was here chapelen ⁊and prestis thre chapeleynprestis thre
Nōnne prest
Monk
¶ A monk þ̉ere was a fayr for the maystrye
An out ridere þᵗat louede uenerye
A manly man to ben an abbot able
Ful manye a deynte hors hadde he in stable
And whan herod men myȝte his brydil here
Gyngelyn in a whistelyng wynd als clere
And ek as loude as doth the chapel belle
There as this lord was kepere of the selle
The reule of seynt Maur / ⁊and of seynt benyght
Be cause that it was old ⁊and sūmdel streyt
This ilke monk let olde thȳnge pace
And held aftyr the newe world the space
He ȝaf not of thattixt a pulled henne
That seith þᵗat hunterys ben not holye menne
Ne that a monk whan he is rekeles
Is lykened to a fysch that is watyrles
